steps.content: The frenzied Sinner smashes open the back door and rushes into the rain. She might've fought off some people along the way, but everything is a blur and she can't remember clearly.
A covert assassination spirals into chaos as an S-Class Sinner goes manic. Back-up is bound to arrive shortly, and this situation can't be sidelined any longer.
Time is running out. Rahu can't make any better decisions. Her consciousness is sucked into the abyss.

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: Mania follows no rules—it distorts all rules, and is beyond human understanding. Thus, it cannot be defeated with logic and rationality. It destroys not only the body, but also the mind. Everyone experiences doubt, fear and confusion, and everyone has their weak spots.

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: The FAC has few weapons to deal with Mania. The most effective one is <color=#fb9259>loyalty</color>. Cast aside your doubts, obey your orders, and trust your superiors and the city-state as much as you believe in victory.

steps.speaker: Solemn Voice
steps.content: The only thing that can stand against Mania is unwavering conviction, whether that be stubbornness or stupidity. Let us devote our lives to fighting it. Let us build DisCity's last barricade.
But in the end, they didn't die where they should have...

steps.speaker: Nauseating Voice
steps.content: A-are you sure you want these? This isn't a trick to bait me out and arrest us, is it?

steps.speaker: Nauseating Voice
steps.content: It-it did make a lot of people stronger, but it also turned some into monsters. I can't guarantee its safety...
Ha... If you want me to do nothing and endure this like a zombie... then I'd rather turn into a monster.

steps.speaker: Aloof Voice
steps.content: You have defended the loftiest values with your lives. You are loyal knights. You are the greatest barricade.

steps.speaker: Aloof Voice
steps.content: But it all ends here. Don't go on further. Don't doubt anything. Get ready to fulfill your next order.

steps.speaker: Aloof Voice
steps.content: That's the meaning of loyalty. That's the meaning of your existence. You've won your compliments. That's it. Don't cross the line.
Save your sophistry! You don't care about her loyalty. As long as you live, her soul will never know peace!

steps.speaker: Nostalgic Voice
steps.content: What is this about again? Your rebellious phase seems to have no end and everything is wrong in your eyes. Is the world really that doomed? Ah, perhaps a little.

steps.speaker: Nostalgic Voice
steps.content: ...A bright future is indeed not guaranteed. Humans haven't had the best luck since Nightfall. But Rahu, even on the darkest night, there are stars. I've found mine. One day, you'll find yours too.

steps.speaker: Nostalgic Voice
steps.content: When you look up at it, you'll find the strength to keep running. And keeping yourself running is the meaning of life.
But you died for nothing. They've taken away the meaning of your death.

steps.speaker: Raven
steps.content: Yes, she died for nothing, but did she really die for Paradeisos?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Didn't she die for you?

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: A vehicle... Rahu, look, a vehicle over there! Get in and start it up, I'll hold off these monsters! Don't die here!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Do you wanna die then? You're an officer, you should live! Move, I'll handle this!

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Get in! This is an order!

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No!!!

She tries to resist but the brawny FAC captain grabs her armor and flings her into the cockpit. The captain slams on the switch and the door is locked. The tides of DisSea crash near and the Corruptors press her onto the glass window instantly, tearing up her armor.
Rahu's sanity was torn from her as she rushed up to the glass, but all she could see was Varna's face twisted in agony. The soldier's body gradually slipped down.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ahh... No!! Open the door!!!

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: I... recruited you... I ought to... protect you till the end...

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Go... Go now...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No, you're wrong, you should have... let me protect you... I...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: She pushes you into the lifeboat and dies alone in the mouths of the monsters.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Protect... yourself...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: She was the noble FAC warrior. She didn't die fighting for her own wish. She died for you. You stripped her death of meaning, so you're responsible for rectifying everything.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Avenge her. Find out who put her on this path. Find the people behind 05257885 and make them pay with their own lives.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You didn't fulfill your duty when she was still alive. Now she's dead, it's time to realize your promise.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!!
Her consciousness burns with pain. Finally, she smashes against the thick glass, growling.
The glass shatters and the chaotic scene in Rahu's sight cracks up gradually. The rain spatters in and she hears a faint mechanical noise.
Beep... Beep beep...
Turn off attack mode. She's an ally.
A blurry figure gradually approaches, carrying a floral scent that repels Rahu.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Such an intense Mania reaction. Where's your face mask? It would have lessened the pain.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Get lost... You bastard... Don't you dare come near me...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your sanity barely remains. You took the most extreme route to obtain Sinner power, didn't you?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Mania Crystal? Or intentional contact with contamination?
She picks up the floral letter on the ground and reads the decoded numbers aloud.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: 05257885... I see, that's why you've approached me. Are you looking for the people behind this number?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Doesn't seem like it's working out. You're getting nowhere with only this.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Come with me, Rahu. You're getting soaked in the rain.
Shalom moves closer to Rahu with an umbrella, meaning to keep her from the rain. But as soon as she takes a step forward, the massive shield is flung and with a smack...
The approaching umbrella almost springs off and the rain instantly shrouds both of them. Mania has long crept onto Rahu's cheeks and slithered into her eyes.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Piss off... You scum from Paradeisos, it's all because of you... she...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Who the hell are you? Get away from me... People like you, people from Paradeisos...

Shalom's forearm is lightly bruised and her shirt is spattered with mud and drenched in rain. But she doesn't hurry to hide from the rain, doesn't so much as shift her gaze, and keeps staring at Rahu silently.
After a moment, Rahu hears that soft voice again.
Rahu hears a barely audible snicker.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I know.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Protecting me isn't part of your FAC mission. You only approached me to get close to Paradeisos, for your revenge.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're a terrible actress.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Hmm...
She tries hard to lift her head to take a good look at this "stranger", but the woman is towering over her, peering down at her.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're a failure of the FAC and a lost avenger. You've forgotten who you are. I'll tell you who you are.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You were once the most loyal knight, but you lost your master and became an ownerless stray.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're utterly disoriented and simply rampaging blindly in the dark. All you do is growl and rage and that has gotten you nothing.
The woman from Paradeisos talks languidly. Her words are gentle like drizzle, but they fall chillingly on Rahu as icicles.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Stop... Shut up...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You act recklessly based on your naive imagination of Paradeisos. You think if you prove your strength and snatch all the achievements, you'll be needed and recognized. That's why you've ended up turning yourself into this.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're wrong. Paradeisos has never needed power, but <color=#fb9259>tools</color>. Reliable, handy tools they can use to resist Mania safely. What's the point of sneaking up behind us if you don't even know that?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Power drives you to take the risks, and your remarkable achievements are a result of your rebellious streak. Your edges are too sharp, you're bound to be ill-fitted in any machine you don't approve of.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't you see how pathetic you are? All you do is prove how unqualified you are to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Then just kill me! Like you did my comrades!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your comrades were much more outstanding and reliable than you. The FAC is deeply trusted, and they were the most loyal tools.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You...!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As for you... No one's gonna kill you. You've pushed yourself into a dead-end. In the end, you've avenged no one and achieved nothing. You've simply made yourself a living joke.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Ahhh!
Rage and Mania erupt simultaneously. Furious, Rahu gets up and charges at her, but she's lost control over her own body, just as the woman has said.

Shalom folds up the umbrella and points its tip on Rahu's shoulder, ever so lightly but enough to keep her down. The burning Blue Rain drips and scalds the freshly pierced wound on Rahu, but also wakes her slowly.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Calm down. Tame the storm in your body and take a good look...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Am I your enemy?

Pain sears her shoulder, but also clears the scarlet in her sight. Rahu's vision refocuses and she can gradually make out the woman before her. Her slender and frail figure looks as though it can be fractured by the drizzle any second.

On her bare skin, scarlet scorch marks emerge vividly among the abundant scars. Compared to Rahu's, the woman's scorch marks are evidently weaker. Ashen-faced, she seems to be on the edge of endurance.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Just like mine... Are you also... a Sinner?

steps.speaker: Security Chief
steps.content: You're pushing it too far! The lady's from Paradeisos. How can we let a Sinner go near her? Their attitude towards Mania is crystal clear!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Times are changing. I lack the ability to protect myself, so I am very glad that you're here.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: No power, no background, a frail body, and not even a family member to seek help from... That's why Paradeisos "chose" her. No one will care if she dies.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's why they banished you...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Not banished. Used. In Paradeisos, to be used means to be trusted.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: My power is not as strong as yours, but I've accomplished every mission assigned to me. As a Sinner, I've won their trust.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...As bait?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As a tool.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As insignificant as me, I'm an excellent tool now... I can open up a genuine path into Paradeisos for you.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: ...Be my tool, let them use you and trust you through me. I'll be your way into Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What are you talking about... I want revenge, I... I can't take orders from you, I...
The woman from Paradeisos peers down at her, a faint glint of pity flickers in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You've done your best. You've resisted fearlessly and fought against the tide, pushing limits. Finally, you've made your way to me. Good job... From now on, just leave it to me.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Be it revenge or relief, I can take you anywhere you want and grant your wish. On only one condition...

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Keep your head clear and protect me. You're a knight, protect me like you did those you once served.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Never be lost again.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I don't understand, why...
A brief silence. Amid the pitter-patter of the rain, Rahu catches a soft, low murmur.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: <size=30>Fate is ruthless. Lost one who treads against all... may you...</size>

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What are you saying...
Rahu tried to discern her expression, but her face remained impassive, almost like sculpted wax. The words, barely audible to begin with, were finally lost amidst the patter of rain.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: A tool doesn't ask questions. Just do as I say.
The Blue Rain falls on her hands. Her umbrella-gripping hand begins to lower, gradually reaching the level of Rahu's chest.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Stand up and make your choice. This is your only chance.

The rain drenches her vibrant red hair and trickles down her eyelids. The Mania reaction it triggers keeps spreading and the scorch mark grows brighter and brighter, yet the woman doesn't bat an eye. She stares straight at Rahu, her gaze deep as a dark pool.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: The one you're to protect is hurting.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What should you do?
Can I trust her? What does she want? Why is she helping me?

A storm of chaotic thoughts sweeps past Rahu's brain and she struggles to find a firm answer. But as if her body has its own mind, her hand reaches out to the umbrella. The Blue Rain hits her bare skin, but the pain wakes her up.
Finally, Rahu takes the umbrella, opens it, and takes a step toward the woman.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...I've only ever wanted to serve one person. And she's no longer alive.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: But I need you to realize your promise. I... forbid you from dying.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: With your protection, I'm not dying anytime soon. Rest assured.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: This time, you can do it.

steps.speaker: Varna
steps.content: Keep running, Rahu. Keeping running, that's the meaning of life.
